articles.description: Union Road Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari has announced that owners of old diesel trucks and buses will be allowed to retrofit their vehicles with a low-cost emission-control device developed from an IIT-Delhi innovation. Newly discovered code references two unreleased controllers with notably different feature sets. The references appeared within code briefly included in macOS 26.7 , first spotted by pdfu, a MacRumors forum regular. The controllers in question are identified as "T6502" and "T1057".
